description: Loaded G-code program streamed by the agent to the dashboard (PROTOCOL.md section 5). Canonical copy: floorwatch/contracts/gcode/v1.json; the agent repo vendors it and its tests check its sender against these numbers.
sender_rule: send only if the program has at most max_program_chars characters AND splits into at most max_chunks packets of at most max_packet_bytes; otherwise send one gcode_file_refused packet instead. Plain ASCII G-code is about 1000 characters per packet, so 32 MiB is about 34000 packets.
receiver_rule: accept total_chunks up to max_chunks and up to max_program_chars assembled characters; memory is bounded by characters and by the number of chunks held for all machines together.
content_sha256: optional in every chunk: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the whole program text as UTF-8; a receiver that finds a mismatch after assembly drops the program
